job.title: SQLI SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Engineer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | 5+ yrs e-commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and microservices. Proven record designing and implementing data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, optimizing SQL performance, and supporting production. Strong techno-functional consulting experience with business analysis, user stories and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SQLI SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Sqli1’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge digital commerce solutions. With 5+ years building SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have the deep technical expertise and industry insight to excel in this role.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), covering product, catalog and pricing modules for global e-commerce.

bullets.label: Java & Spring Mastery
bullets.text: Developed high-performance Java services using Spring Framework and Spring Boot, and built OCC REST APIs consumed by storefronts and third-party systems.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring seamless product data synchronization across ERP and MDM.

bullets.label: Production & Performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and provided 24/7 production support, reducing latency and improving transaction speed for mission-critical commerce operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work in Germany. I welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Sqli1.

tailoring.why_company: Sqli1 is a leader in digital transformation, helping enterprises modernise their commerce landscape with SAP Commerce Cloud. I admire your commitment to innovative, scalable e-commerce platforms and your focus on delivering measurable business value. My background delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns perfectly with your projects, and I am eager to bring my technical depth and techno-functional consulting experience to your team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Excited to leverage my 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive Sqli1’s innovative e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a SAP Commerce Cloud backend specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to Sqli1’s SAP Commerce projects.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SQLI SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SQLI SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer role at Sqli1. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java, Spring and API integration expertise. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.
